scope: Official-source departure requirements for a Venezuelan third-country national leaving Madrid, Spain on a professional employment move to Ireland (ES->IE corridor). Covers municipal de-registration from the Madrid padron (madrid.es), Spanish Social Security posted-worker mechanics and the A1/TA.300 certificate for those kept on a Spanish contract (seg-social.es), and the AEAT tax-exit / non-resident transition: fiscal-domicile change via Modelo 030, early non-resident withholding via Modelo 247, the 183-day residence rule with no mid-year split, and the non-resident IRNR self-assessment Modelo 210 (agenciatributaria.gob.es). Facts are verbatim-sourced from official government hosts only; legal/tax determinations are flagged for lawyer review. Candidate-only: review_status=pending, verification_status=representative.
